name: Sheet
description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class Sheet < Base
    def initialize(open: false, **attrs)
      @open = open
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    # `contents` keeps the Stimulus wrapper out of layout, like shadcn's
    # element-less Root.
    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "sheet",
          controller: "ruby-ui--sheet",
          ruby_ui__sheet_open_value: @open.to_s
        },
        class: "contents"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The sheet panel: a native <dialog> opened with showModal(), so the browser
  # makes the page behind inert and handles Esc and initial focus. Styled after
  # shadcn's SheetContent (Base UI + vega).
  #
  # Side classes are plain utilities (not data-[side=…] variants) so a caller's
  # width or padding replaces them through tailwind_merge.
  class SheetContent < Base
    SIDE_CLASS = {
      top: "inset-x-0 top-0 bottom-auto h-auto w-full border-b " \
        "data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top-10 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-top-10",
      right: "inset-y-0 right-0 left-auto h-full w-3/4 border-l sm:max-w-sm " \
        "data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-right-10 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-right-10",
      bottom: "inset-x-0 bottom-0 top-auto h-auto w-full border-t " \
        "data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-bottom-10 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-bottom-10",
      left: "inset-y-0 left-0 right-auto h-full w-3/4 border-r sm:max-w-sm " \
        "data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-left-10 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-left-10"
    }.freeze

    def initialize(side: :right, show_close_button: true, **attrs)
      @side = SIDE_CLASS.key?(side.to_s.to_sym) ? side.to_s.to_sym : :right
      @show_close_button = show_close_button
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      dialog(**attrs) do
        yield if block_given?
        close_button if @show_close_button
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "sheet-content",
          side: @side,
          ruby_ui__sheet_target: "content",
          # Only for markup that still calls ruby-ui--sheet-content#close.
          controller: "ruby-ui--sheet-content",
          action: "pointerdown->ruby-ui--sheet#backdropPointerdown click->ruby-ui--sheet#backdropClick"
        },
        class: [
          # <dialog> UA styles: fixed inset 0, max width/height and fit-content size.
          "fixed z-50 m-0 max-h-none max-w-none flex-col gap-4 bg-popover bg-clip-padding text-sm text-popover-foreground shadow-lg outline-none open:flex not-open:hidden",
          "backdrop:bg-black/10 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop:backdrop-blur-xs",
          "duration-200 ease-in-out data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:fill-mode-forwards motion-reduce:animate-none!",
          "backdrop:duration-150 data-[state=open]:backdrop:animate-in data-[state=open]:backdrop:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:backdrop:animate-out data-[state=closed]:backdrop:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:backdrop:fill-mode-forwards motion-reduce:backdrop:animate-none!",
          SIDE_CLASS.fetch(@side)
        ]
      }
    end

    # shadcn renders <Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm">; the classes are
    # inlined because Button's own data-slot would be mixed into sheet-close.
    def close_button
      button(
        type: "button",
        class: "absolute top-4 end-4 size-8 shrink-0 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] inline-flex items-center justify-center border border-transparent bg-clip-padding text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap outline-none select-none transition-all hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50 aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 active:not-aria-[haspopup]:translate-y-px disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg]:size-4",
        data: {slot: "sheet-close", action: "click->ruby-ui--sheet#dismiss"}
      ) do
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          aria_hidden: "true"
        ) do |s|
          s.path(d: "M18 6 6 18")
          s.path(d: "m6 6 12 12")
        end
        span(class: "sr-only") { "Close" }
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class SheetDescription < Base
    def view_template(&)
      p(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "sheet-description", ruby_ui__sheet_target: "description"},
        class: "text-sm text-muted-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class SheetFooter < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "sheet-footer"},
        class: "mt-auto flex flex-col gap-2 p-4"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class SheetHeader < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "sheet-header"},
        class: "flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-4"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Body between header and footer. shadcn has no part for it; its examples
  # wrap the body in <div className="px-4">, which this mirrors.
  class SheetMiddle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "px-4"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class SheetTitle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      h2(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "sheet-title", ruby_ui__sheet_target: "title"},
        class: "font-heading font-medium text-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Wraps the element that opens the sheet. The controller puts
  # aria-haspopup/aria-expanded/aria-controls on the button or link inside.
  class SheetTrigger < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "sheet-trigger",
          ruby_ui__sheet_target: "trigger",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--sheet#open"
        },
        class: "inline-block"
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Sheet

Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
Sheet do
  SheetTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  SheetContent do
    SheetHeader do
      SheetTitle { "Edit profile" }
      SheetDescription { "Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done." }
    end
    SheetMiddle(class: "grid gap-6") do
      div(class: "grid gap-3") do
        FormFieldLabel(for: "sheet-demo-name") { "Name" }
        Input(id: "sheet-demo-name", value: "Joel Drapper")
      end
      div(class: "grid gap-3") do
        FormFieldLabel(for: "sheet-demo-email") { "Email" }
        Input(id: "sheet-demo-email", value: "joel@drapper.me")
      end
    end
    SheetFooter do
      Button { "Save changes" }
      Button(variant: :outline, data: { action: 'click->ruby-ui--sheet#dismiss' }) { "Close" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Side

```ruby
div(class: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2') do
  [:top, :right, :bottom, :left].each do |side|
    Sheet do
      SheetTrigger do
        Button(variant: :outline, class: 'capitalize') { side.to_s }
      end
      SheetContent(side: side) do
        SheetHeader do
          SheetTitle { "Edit profile" }
          SheetDescription { "Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done." }
        end
        SheetMiddle do
          p(class: 'text-sm text-muted-foreground') { "The sheet slides in from the \#{side}." }
        end
        SheetFooter do
          Button { "Save changes" }
          Button(variant: :outline, data: { action: 'click->ruby-ui--sheet#dismiss' }) { "Cancel" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### No close button

```ruby
Sheet do
  SheetTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open Sheet" }
  end
  SheetContent(show_close_button: false) do
    SheetHeader do
      SheetTitle { "No close button" }
      SheetDescription { "This sheet doesn't have a close button in the top-right corner. Press Esc or click outside to close it." }
    end
  end
end
```
